claims.text: GC reports revenue from sale of goods and rendering of services of THB 321,623,378,078 for the six-month period ended 30 June 2026.
GC reports profit attributable to owners of the company of THB 15,440,108,311 for the six-month period ended 30 June 2026.
GC reports revenue from sale of goods and rendering of services of THB 267,039,166,374 for the six-month period ended 30 June 2025.
GC reports loss attributable to owners of the company of THB -6,183,328,551 for the six-month period ended 30 June 2025.
GC's most recent quarterly revenue (three months ended 30 June 2026) was THB 173,868,786,522.
GC's most recent quarterly profit attributable to owners of the company (three months ended 30 June 2026) was THB 12,208,350,223.
GC reports in Thai Baht (THB) and uses 'ones' as units; the fiscal year end is not explicitly stated in the evidence.
PETRONAS Group reports revenue from continuing operations of RM 266.1 billion for the financial year ended 31 December 2025.
PETRONAS Group reports EBITDA of RM 103.0 billion for the financial year ended 31 December 2025.
PETRONAS Group reports profit after tax (PAT) from continuing operations of RM 45.4 billion for the financial year ended 31 December 2025.
PETRONAS Group's most recent half-year revenue (first half ended 30 June 2025) was RM 132.6 billion.
PETRONAS Group's most recent half-year EBITDA (first half ended 30 June 2025) was RM 54.4 billion.
PETRONAS Group's most recent half-year profit after tax (PAT) (first half ended 30 June 2025) was RM 26.2 billion.
PETRONAS Group reports in Malaysian Ringgit (MYR) and uses 'millions' as units; fiscal year end is 31 December.
No financial results for Reliance Industries Limited or Reliance's petrochemical segment are present in the evidence provided.
No financial results for PETRONAS Chemicals Group (PCG) are present in the evidence provided; all PETRONAS figures are for the PETRONAS Group as a whole.
GC does not disclose adjusted EBITDA in the evidence provided.
PETRONAS Group describes its outlook as impacted by lower average realised prices, foreign exchange, and lower sales volume, with profitability and ROACE declining in 2025 compared to 2024.
